thread:
lena: Heads-up — we plan to cut runtime v0.15.0 and api v0.14.3 tomorrow at 11:00 PT. Quick sync: any breaking changes expected from console/SDK teams? Need final changelog bullets + PR links.

raj: Console team: no contract changes, just a few copy tweaks and a minor telemetry flag. I'll push a changelog entry by EOD. :+1:

sam: SDK: there's a tiny auth header name change (see PR #412) — nonbreaking for most clients but requires the header mapping in the Android SDK. PR is ready and needs review. @lena can you ping mobile infra for a quick look?

lena: pinging @sam and mobile infra — can someone volunteer to review #412 today? If not, we may gate the SDK bump until after cut.

donna: Docker/CI: I need the runtime final tag to bake images. What's the expected runtime tag naming?

azu: runtime: no API surface changes. Internal kernel swap for quantized paths only. I'll create tag `runtime/v0.15.0-rc1` at 10:30 PT and promote to `v0.15.0` after CI. Will post the sha here once created.

lena: thanks @azu — please include a one-line changelog bullet we can copy into the release notes.

raj: CHANGES.md note (console): "Update telemetry opt-in wording; internal metrics cleanup." I'll open the PR in 30m.

sam: @lena I asked @mike-mobile to eyeball #412; he said he'll review around lunch. If he approves, I can merge and cut `sdk/0.14.0` tag before the release window.

donna: noted — I'll queue the build once @azu posts the runtime sha. Will set the image tag to `redwood/runtime:v0.15.0-<sha8>` and create a staging rollout at 12:30 PT.

deploy-bot: scheduled: staging rollout runtime:v0.15.0-rc1 -> 12:30 PT (auto-rollback 10m).

lena: tiny checklist for tomorrow: 1) runtime tag + sha (azu) 2) console changelog PR (raj) 3) sdk PR review + tag (sam) 4) docs + changelog aggregation (me) 5) staging rollout & smoke tests (donna). If any team expects delays, call them out now.

azu: runtime changelog line: "Improve quantized attention kernel selection for lower latency on short sequences." Will post sha at 10:28 PT.

sam: gotcha. If mobile approves, I'll merge and tag by 10:50. Otherwise, we'll push the SDK to a hotfix slot after GA.

raj: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/console/pull/798 — changelog entry included.

lena: perfect. I'll compile the final release notes and paste here at 10:55 PT for a quick sign-off before cut. :sparkles:

mike-mobile: reviewed #412 — looks fine to me, one small comment. Resolved, ready to merge. :thumbsup:

lena: thanks all — keeping this thread as the single source of truth for the cut. If anything blocks, post here and I'll escalate.

(End)
